Title: Add Grey Jacket to cart and remove it successfully
Preconditions: User has network access to storefront
Steps:
1. Navigate to Grey Jacket product page
2. Click 'Add to Cart' button
3. Navigate to My Cart page
4. Click remove item button ('x')
Expected Result: Grey Jacket is removed from cart; Cart displays empty state without the product
Test Data: URL: https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/products/grey-jacket | Product: Grey jacket | Action: Add to Cart -> My Cart -> Remove
